features: lagged residual when a team was favored by 6+ points
team-conditioned sliding market/model weight from prior Brier advantage
optional divisional spread compression searched by the historical trainer
strict prior-week-only state for weekly backtests
promotion_rule: Must beat the static market-aware baseline overall on future seasons, improve a majority of held-out seasons, and avoid a >0.002 Brier regression in any single held-out season.
important: The 0.2095 score is still the only promoted market-aware benchmark. The v3 parameters above are research defaults, not a new validated score.
